text: The University of Central Missouri Catalogs contains a wealth of information for students, staff, and faculty members. Students should examine their catalog carefully. This catalog is a reliable guide for entering the university, reviewing available programs of study, selecting courses, and meeting graduation requirements. To the extent possible, the university will accept the degree/certificate requirements in it for an eight-year period. Since the policies and programs of the university are constantly changing, no catalog can be completely up-to-date, even when it is published. Therefore, students should review their programs periodically with a success advisor and with faculty advisors to allow for necessary changes. Individual schools and degree programs may have policies and requirements that are more stringent than the general university policies. Announcements in catalogs are subject to change and thus do not constitute an agreement or contract. Every effort is made to provide accurate and up-to-date information; however, the university reserves the right to change without notice statements concerning rules, policies, fees, curricula, courses or other matters when necessary.

section: Office of the Registrar and Student Records

text: The Office of the Registrar and Student Records, also known as the Registrar’s Office, supports the University of Central Missouri’s mission to “disseminate knowledge that transforms students into leaders who possess the aptitudes, skills and confidence to succeed.” The mission of the Registrar’s Office is to support the academic goals of the university and promote student success by providing timely, accurate, quality services to students, faculty, staff, alumni, parents, and other university constituents. In order to fulfill this mission, the Office of the Registrar & Student Records: Provides secure and confidential maintenance of student academic records in perpetuity. Complies with the mandates of the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA). Interprets, implements, ensures compliance, and communicates changes regarding academic policies and procedures. Assesses student progression toward timely completion of educational goals. Supports a positive work environment based on integrity, service, and inclusion.
title: UCM Office of the Registrar and Student Records

text: The Office of the Registrar and Student Records supports and abides by the UCM Ethics Policy and Nondiscrimination/Equal Opportunity Statement as set forth by the Board of Governors. We also adhere to the best practices and ethical standards adopted by the American Association of Collegiate Registrars and Admissions Officers (AACRAO) and to the Professional Standards for Higher Education as outlined by the Council for the Advancement of Standards in Higher Education (CAS) .

title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Policy Handbook

text: Under this fixture policy, an undergraduate student may request grade replacement for a course in which a grade of D or F was earned. Only the higher grade is used when computing the fixture GPA after an approved replacement. Graduate students follow a separate graduate catalog rule and are not covered by this handbook section. Students must submit a grade replacement request to the fixture Registrar before the last day of classes in the term of the retake. A maximum of 9 credit hours may be replaced under this fixture rule.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Policy Handbook

text: Undergraduate students whose cumulative fixture GPA falls below 2.00 are placed on academic probation. Students on probation must meet with an academic advisor within the first two weeks of the following term.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Policy Handbook

text: Candidates for undergraduate degrees must file a graduation application with the fixture Registrar by the published deadline for the intended commencement term. Late applications may delay diploma processing but do not automatically remove a student from the degree audit queue.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Policy Handbook

text: NOTICE: Synthetic fixture text for CampusAsk tests only. Not official UCM policy.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Undergraduate Catalog Excerpt
section: Sample Undergraduate Catalog Excerpt — Development Fixture

text: Undergraduate students in good academic standing may enroll in up to 18 credit hours per fall or spring term without special approval. Enrollment above 18 hours requires written permission from the academic advisor and a minimum fixture GPA of 3.00.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Undergraduate Catalog Excerpt

text: An undergraduate minor in this fixture catalog requires a minimum of 18 credit hours, including at least 9 hours at the upper-division level. Courses used for a major may not fully satisfy a minor unless the fixture department explicitly allows overlap.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Undergraduate Catalog Excerpt

text: Undergraduate students may withdraw from a course through the published withdrawal deadline. Withdrawals after the deadline require documented extenuating circumstances approved by the fixture academic dean.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Undergraduate Catalog Excerpt

text: NOTICE: Synthetic fixture text for CampusAsk tests only. Not official UCM policy.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Graduate Catalog Excerpt
section: Sample Graduate Catalog Excerpt — Development Fixture

text: Graduate students may replace a grade only with department approval and only for a course in which a grade of C or lower was earned. The original grade remains on the transcript; both attempts appear, and the replacement policy differs from the undergraduate handbook rule.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Graduate Catalog Excerpt

text: Full-time graduate enrollment is defined as 9 credit hours in a fall or spring term under this fixture catalog. Overloads above 12 hours require graduate dean approval.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Graduate Catalog Excerpt

text: Thesis candidates must submit the final approved thesis to the Graduate School by the published fixture deadline for the graduation term. Failure to meet the deadline may postpone conferral to the next term.
title: [DEV FIXTURE] Sample Graduate Catalog Excerpt
